Used as an emulsifier ingredient in solvent cleaners and soluble oils for metal cleaning. Provides highly stable emulsions over a wide range of water hardness when used in combination with petroleum sulfonates in soluble oil formulations.
It is designed mainly as an emulsifier promoting detergent or cleaning activity, particularly in highly built industrial metal cleaners.

It enhances specific adhesion to polyolefin substrates and recycled corrugated board. It promotes cohesive strength and offers good moisture resistance when used in pressure sensitive adhesives. It may be used in clear film label applications due to its good color retention and oxidation resistance.
It is highly hydrogenated and promotes high temperature performance in waterborne pressure sensitive adhesives

It is recommended for use in food packaging applications such as closures, lidding, and cold seal adhesives, as well as pressure sensitive adhesives that contact food. It is also used in adhesives applications requiring higher temperature strength such as in high temperature masking tapes, packaging tapes, and contact adhesives

It is recommended for water-based contact adhesives where fast break properties are required as in foam to foam bonding applications.
It is recommended as a single tackifier for anionic polychloroprene latex polymers used in contact adhesive applications.
It is ideal for “low peel” applications, as it imparts peel strength in small increments relative to resination level. It also exhibits good storage and mechanical stability.
It is recommended as a tackifier for isoprene rubber and natural rubber latex polymers used in tape applications promoting high peel and cohesive strength.
